sections.section_title: High-speed OTG PHY connected to OTG
sections.text_helper: Section 73.4.5 "High-speed OTG PHY connected to OTG" in chapter 73 (USB on-the-go high-speed (OTG)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 3764.
sections.section_content:
Note: Refer to implementation table to determine if an HS PHY is embedded.
The USB OTG core includes an internal UTMI interface which is connected to the
embedded HS PHY (see Section73.4.1: OTG block diagram).
